meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描各大网文平台排行榜,提炼当下热门题材与市场趋势
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在写长篇网文,想先摸清平台榜单上什么题材正火
copy.tagline_en: Scan web-novel platform rankings to surface hot genres and market trends
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want to know which genres are trending before you start

howto.what: 它会采集起点、番茄、晋江等平台的排行榜数据,清洗后输出扫榜报告(题材热度排行、新题材信号、关键数据洞察),再产出一份选题决策.md,给出可写方向、可行性判断和失败风险。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜,或说「长篇什么火」「起点排行」等时接管;若没给方向,它会先问你想看哪个平台(起点/番茄/晋江)和题材方向。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜,看看现在什么题材火
say.note: 它会采集榜单并输出扫榜报告

say.text: 看一下番茄的新书榜,找找新题材信号
say.note: 采集新书榜数据并提取信号

say.text: 根据这次扫榜结果,给我两三个能写的选题
say.note: 在输出目录写入 选题决策.md

howto.what_en: It scrapes ranking charts from Qidian, Fanqie, Jinjiang and other platforms, cleans the data, then outputs a scan report (genre heat ranking, new-genre signals, key data) plus a topic-decision file with writable directions, feasibility and failure risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story-long-scan, /长篇扫榜 or phrases like "what's hot in long-form web novels"; if you give no direction it first asks which platform (Qidian/Fanqie/Jinjiang) and genre you want.

say_en.text: Scan the Qidian monthly ticket chart and tell me which genres are hot.
say_en.note: Collects the chart and returns a scan report.

say_en.text: Look at Fanqie's new-book chart for new genre signals.
say_en.note: Collects new-book data and extracts signals.

say_en.text: Give me two or three writable topics based on this scan.
say_en.note: Writes 选题决策.md into the output folder.
